# Download en-US linux64 (English, 64-bit Linux) Thunderbird binary
$CURL -o "${WORKSPACE}/thunderbird.tar.xz" \
    "${CANDIDATES_DIR}/${VERSION}-candidates/build${BUILD_NUMBER}/linux-x86_64/en-US/thunderbird-${VERSION}.tar.xz"

# Download and extract en-US linux64 binary
$CURL -o "${WORKSPACE}/${PRODUCT}.tar.xz" \
    "${CANDIDATES_DIR}/${VERSION}-candidates/build${BUILD_NUMBER}/linux-x86_64/en-US/${PRODUCT}-${VERSION}.tar.xz"
tar -C "$SOURCE_DEST" -Jxf "${WORKSPACE}/${PRODUCT}.tar.xz" --strip-components=1

text: Entry 1369 replaces .tar.bz2 with .tar.xz in candidate and nightly artifact mappings, signatures/checksum references, locale artifact names and Flatpak/Snap inputs. Those strings join producer and consumer paths. For this release archive, recommend checking all those boundaries during an extension rename rather than treating the filename as presentation text. The change does not imply other package types use XZ. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.
title: Archive renames cross release manifests, locale artifacts and repackagers
